svg.title: A decision-node measurement case in MTTravel-Bench
svg.desc: An NTSB air report is converted into a causal history ending at a Mental Time Travel decision node. Task 1 scores possible next actions across STR, SP, SC, and utility. Task 2 predicts the actual outcome after the factual action.

g.text: Air report → marked fields → extracted events → causal knowledge graph → decision.
At night, a Part 135 flight was 5 miles north
of its destination at 3,000 ft when it encountered birds.
The crew did not see the birds before impact.
The bird strike made the captain's
after the primary flight display fails?
Generate options and score each one.
Shown values are benchmark targets for Task 1.
